run: qs ipc call debug dump | jq -r .popout.name
qs ipc call debug dump | jq -r .popout.phase
qs ipc call debug dump | jq -r '[.popout.name, .popout.side] | join("/")'

B=$(qs ipc call debug bars); D=$(qs ipc call debug dump); jq -nr --argjson b "$B" --argjson d "$D" '
  $d.popout as $p | $d.win as $w | $p.frame as [$fx,$fy,$fw,$fh] |
  ($b | map(select(.screen == $b[0].screen))) as $bars |
  ($bars | map(select(.edge == "left"))[0].geom) as [$bx,$by,$bw,$bh] |
  {
    name: ($p.name == "bluetooth"),
    side: ($p.side == "right"),
    inWindow: ($fx >= 0 and $fy >= 0 and $fx + $fw <= $w.w and $fy + $fh <= $w.h),
    clearOfEveryBar: ($bars | all(.geom as [$ax,$ay,$aw,$ah] | $fy >= $ay + $ah or $fy + $fh <= $ay or $fx >= $ax + $aw or $fx + $fw <= $ax)),
    nearTrigger: ($fx - ($bx + $bw) >= 0 and $fx - ($bx + $bw) <= 12),
    overTrigger: ($p.trigger as [$tx,$ty,$tw,$th] | ($ty + $th/2 >= $fy and $ty + $th/2 <= $fy + $fh))
  } | [.[]] | all'
qs ipc call debug dump | jq -c .popout
